palette: Rich bark brown, fresh green-gold cambium, and small emerald leaf accents.
valueRange: Deep natural body with bright living seams.
surfaceAndWear: Supple bark, polished exposed grain, healed cuts, tiny fresh buds, no dead splintering.
constructionVocabulary: Actively grown curves, entwined branches, leaflike tips, root-grip structures, seamless living joints.
supernaturalBehavior: Selected buds and cambium lines emit a faint green-gold vitality; growth remains bounded.
neutralSecondaryMaterials: Gold-bronze caps, dark leather, natural cord, and muted green cloth.
neighborDifference: Lusher, more alive, and more dynamically grown than Spiritwood; smaller and less primordial than Worldtree Limb.
